_comment: Mutation testing for issue #97 (PDF export formatting). Based on Bennett Matuszewski's stryker.config.json from #163, including the command runner workaround below. Run from packages/desktop-client: npx stryker run stryker.issue-97.config.json
testRunner_comment: The Vitest runner (@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10.0.0) reports every mutant as surviving with Vitest 5: its initial run works, but no tests run for any mutant. The command runner starts Vitest once per mutant and switches the mutant on through __STRYKER_ACTIVE_MUTANT__.
concurrency_comment: At 4, the after run reported 4 equivalent mutants (budgetMonthPdf.ts lines 114-117) as timeouts because the machine was overloaded; Stryker counts timeouts as kills. At 2 there are no timeouts.
